June 6, 2018 - By Jonathan Benavides
Albion Financial Group increased its stake in Costco Wholesale Corp (COST) by 93.61% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Albion Financial Group bought 13,277 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.88% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 27,460 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.17M, up from 14,183 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Albion Financial Group who had been investing in Costco Wholesale Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $86.82B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.78 during the last trading session, reaching $197.84. About 1.85 million shares traded.
